def loadGame():
    global session, gui, fife

    # Implementing load dialog
    file_path = fife.pychan.loadFileDialog('Load Game', 'Select a game file to load', '*.save')
    if file_path:
        session.end()
        session = None

        if gui is not None:
            gui.hide()
        gui = fife.pychan.loadXML('content/gui/loadingscreen.xml')
        gui.x += int((settings.fife.screen.width - gui.width) / 2)
        gui.y += int((settings.fife.screen.height - gui.height) / 2)
        gui.show()
        fife.engine.pump()

        session = Session()
        session.begin()
        session.load(file_path)
        returnGame()
